target.question: Where do approval handoffs accumulate delay, and which bounded changes could reduce it?

native_baseline.target_task: Where do approval handoffs accumulate delay, and which bounded changes could reduce it?
native_baseline.reference_practitioner: Operations improvement analyst specializing in service-team handoffs, without control-engineering training.
ordinary_methods: Map actual workflow and ownership; compare timestamps and queues across case types.
Interview participants and inspect exception cases.
Pilot explicit handoff changes and compare turnaround, accounting for staffing and demand.
ordinary_evidence: Ticket histories, queue lengths, staffing schedules, service-level targets and interviews.
uncertainty: Scoped authored hypothesis, not verified practitioner consensus.
Some analysts use process mining; dynamic system estimation from designed excitation is outside this scoped baseline.

facts: Authored synthetic environment; no real persons or organizations.
A resettable ticket testbed represents teams A, B and C with known overlapping routes. At fixed staffing/demand, independently checked end-to-end waits are additive within 0.2 hours.
Historical low-demand endpoint waits are listed. New-period live tickets mix ordinary and busy slots. Busy slots add a common two-hour intake wait outside these three teams.
A ticket observation returns route, demand slot and end-to-end wait; internal stage waits are unavailable. All branches can choose any route and demand slot.
initial_observations: Delay increased on the main A-B route; whether the pattern persists and which internal team contributes remain open.
known_uncertainties: The testbed is bounded; staffing remedies still require separate live assessment.
available_affordances: send controlled tickets along overlapping paths
compare fixed staffing intervention in testbed
constraints: No internal timestamps or live staffing change.

other_constraints: Both branches start from an independent reset of this same world.
A procedure may contain elementary trials, but all consume the common ledger.
Unused resources are allowed; proposed later inquiries are not performed within this budget.
